# PDF.js 3.11.174

Mozilla PDF.js, used to render the lecture slides in the Slides & Revision viewer.

- Source: https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/pdf.js/3.11.174/ (`pdf.min.js`, `pdf.worker.min.js`), unmodified
- Project: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
- License: Apache License 2.0 (notice at the top of each file), https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0

The files are self-hosted so the viewer works on GitHub Pages without a third-party CDN.
